reside in Taipei: My cousin used to live in the countryside, but now she works and resides in Taipei with her husband.
我表姊以前住在鄉下，但現在她和先生在台北工作、居住在台北。
power resides in the people: In a true democracy, power resides in the people, who choose their leaders through free elections.
在真正的民主國家，權力屬於人民，人民透過自由選舉選出領導者。
the problem resides in: Our team keeps losing, but the problem resides in poor communication, not in the players' skills.
我們隊伍一直輸，但問題在於溝通不良，而不是球員的技術。
reside abroad: Many Taiwanese engineers reside abroad for years before they finally return home to start their own companies.
許多台灣工程師旅居國外多年，最後才回國創立自己的公司。
resign from office: After the scandal became public, the mayor had no choice but to resign from office last week.
醜聞曝光後，市長上週別無選擇只能辭職。
resign oneself to fate: After losing his job and his house, he felt he had no choice but to resign himself to fate.
失去工作和房子之後，他覺得別無選擇，只能認命。
be resigned to the fact: After her knee injury, she was resigned to the fact that she would never play professional basketball.
膝蓋受傷後，她無奈接受事實：她永遠無法打職業籃球了。
resign as chairman: Feeling tired after ten years in charge, Mr. Lin decided to resign as chairman so a younger leader could take over.
掌權十年後感到疲憊，林先生決定辭去主席職務，讓較年輕的領導者接手。
resist temptation: Although the cake looked delicious, she managed to resist temptation because she was trying to eat healthier.
雖然蛋糕看起來很好吃，她還是成功抗拒誘惑，因為她正努力吃得更健康。
resist change: Some older workers resist change because they are afraid new technology will make their jobs harder.
有些年長員工抗拒改變，因為他們擔心新科技會讓工作變得更困難。
resist arrest: The thief tried to resist arrest by running away, but the police caught him at the corner.
小偷試圖逃跑拒捕，但警察在轉角抓到了他。
can't resist chocolate: I know sweets are bad for my teeth, but I just can't resist chocolate when I feel stressed.
我知道甜食對牙齒不好，但我一感到壓力就無法抗拒巧克力。
resist the urge: During the exam, try to resist the urge to check your phone, or the teacher may take it away.
考試時要忍住衝動別去看手機，否則老師可能會沒收。
resist pressure: The young judge was able to resist pressure from powerful people and made a fair decision.
那位年輕法官頂住來自權貴的壓力，做出了公正的判決。
resolve a conflict: The teacher helped the two students resolve a conflict by asking each of them to listen calmly to the other.
老師要兩位學生各自冷靜聆聽對方，幫助他們解決衝突。
resolve to quit: Every January, many people firmly resolve to quit eating junk food, but most of them give up by February.
每年一月，許多人下決心戒掉垃圾食物，但大多數人到二月就放棄了。
resolve the issue: The engineers worked all night to resolve the issue, and the website was running normally again by morning.
工程師們熬夜解決問題，網站到早上就恢復正常運作了。
resolve differences: The two countries held several meetings to resolve differences over trade before signing the new agreement.
兩國在簽署新協議前舉行了數次會議，以化解在貿易上的分歧。
resolve a dispute: The neighbors asked a lawyer to help them resolve a dispute over where the fence between their houses should be.
鄰居們請律師協助解決爭端，問題是兩家之間的圍籬該設在哪裡。
resort to violence: No matter how angry you are, you should never resort to violence to solve problems with others.
無論你有多生氣，都絕不該訴諸暴力來解決與他人的問題。
as a last resort: We tried every medicine at home, and only as a last resort did we take the dog to the animal hospital.
我們試過家裡所有的藥，最後手段才帶狗去動物醫院。
resort to lying: When he couldn't explain the missing money, he chose to resort to lying, which only made his parents angrier.
當他無法解釋錢為何不見時，他只好說謊，結果只讓父母更生氣。
resort to force: The police did not want to resort to force, so they talked calmly with the angry crowd for hours.
警方不想動用武力，所以他們花了好幾個小時冷靜地和憤怒的群眾溝通。
respect one's privacy: I asked my mom to respect my privacy and stop reading the messages on my phone without asking.
我請媽媽尊重我的隱私，不要未經詢問就看我手機裡的訊息。
respect the law: Every citizen should respect the law, even when they think a certain rule is not perfect.
每位公民都應該遵守法律，即使他們認為某條規定並不完美。
respect one's wishes: Grandma did not want a big party, so we decided to respect her wishes and have a quiet dinner at home.
奶奶不想辦大型派對，所以我們決定尊重她的意願，在家裡安靜地吃晚餐。
in this respect: The new phone has a much better camera, and in this respect it is far better than the old model.
新手機的相機好很多，就這方面來說，它遠比舊款好。
with respect to: With respect to your question about the school trip, I will send you the details by email tomorrow.
關於你詢問的校外教學問題，我明天會用電子郵件寄詳細資料給你。
pay one's respects: Hundreds of people came to the funeral to pay their respects to the brave firefighter.
數百人前來參加葬禮，向那位英勇的消防員致敬。
